title: ai-rulez verifiers report
description: The report printed by `ai-rulez verifiers run --format json` (and the result of the MCP run_verifiers tool, which adds ok and cannot_run): one result per verifier, with the findings and the rule or skill each verifier enforces.

mode.description: Which files counted as changed: "all", "since <rev>" or "staged".

skipped.description: llm verifiers that were not evaluated (AR9H4); present only when non-zero.

inactive.description: Verifiers whose rule or skill is outside the active profile or role; present only when non-zero.

llm.description: Model use of the run; present when an llm verifier called a model or --estimate ran.

cached.description: Calls answered from the response cache.

name.description: The verifier id (or the declaration file of an invalid one).

type.description: The root predicate: file_exists, file_absent, glob_count, regex, forbid, key_equals, generated_in_sync, paired, command, llm, all, any, not, examples (AR9H6), or invalid.

code.description: AR9H1 predicate did not hold, AR9H2 invalid declaration, AR9H3 command refused or did not run, AR9H4 llm verifier skipped, AR9H5 dead when_changed scope, AR9H6 no self-test examples.

source.description: The declaration file under .ai-rulez/verifiers/, or include:<name>/verifiers/<file> for an imported one.

advisory.description: A model produced the verdict: the severity is at most warning.

target.description: The rule, skill, agent or command a verifier enforces.

path.description: Source file relative to the project root.

match.description: The offending text, at most 120 characters, credential-looking text masked.
